description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Quality Info Record provides a way to interact with the [Quality Info Record API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_QUALITYINFORECORD_SRV/overview). The service allows to create, read, update and delete quality info records in procurement and the related first article inspections.
key-features: Create, read, update and delete quality info records for supplier and material combinations
Create, read, update and delete first article inspections
Navigate between quality info records and their first article inspections
